spec.title: Text helpers for display
spec.body:
## Problem Statement

Strings arriving from external sources need normalising before they are shown or used in URLs.

## Solution

A small set of pure text helpers, exported from the text module.

## User Stories

1. As a caller, I want a slug from any title, so that I can build a URL path from it.

## Testing Decisions

The seam is `src/text.js`'s exported functions, tested through their public interface with `node --test`. Prior art: `test/text.test.js` covers `titleCase` this way. Do not test internals; there are none.

slices.title: slugify for URL paths
slices.body:
## What to build

A caller can turn any display title into a URL-safe slug.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `slugify` is exported from `src/text.js`
- [ ] Lowercases, and replaces runs of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen
- [ ] No leading or trailing hyphen: `slugify(" Hello, There! ")` is `"hello-there"`
- [ ] An empty or punctuation-only string yields `""`
- [ ] Covered by tests at the seam the spec names
